title: Tyler Shough: Jordyn Tyson is "so sure-handed" and "an elite separator"

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Tyler Shough: Jordyn Tyson is "so sure-handed" and "an elite separator"
sources.description: With the No. 8 overall pick of this year’s draft, the Saints added a player who should be able to make a major impact on their offense in receiver Jordyn Tyson.
